IOS_BLOCK_DEVICE_TOPOLOGY_PROVEN.topology: one physical ANS NVMe namespace per APFS container: System container (Rave24A437.D37OS) and Cryptex container (Rave24A437.D37SystemCryptex) are separate containers

IOS_BLOCK_DEVICE_TOPOLOGY_PROVEN.cryptex_attach: Cryptex is composed by userspace/launchd at boot (Cryptex1,SystemOS role), not part of the System container
IOS_BLOCK_DEVICE_TOPOLOGY_PROVEN.root_device: XNU root-device expectation = ANS NVMe namespace containing the System container

IOS_ROOT_TRANSITION_MODEL_PROVEN.meaning: ramdisk/auxiliary media + System volume: boot firmware loads kernel + auxiliary restore ramdisk (rd=md0), kernel mounts System from the ANS namespace and launches launchd; Cryptex SystemOS is composed on top
flow: kernel -> ANS2DARTNVMeController -> NVMe namespace (System APFS container)
launchd composes Cryptex1 SystemOS on top
IOS_ROOT_TRANSITION_MODEL_PROVEN.note: The restore ramdisk is NOT the final root; it is auxiliary boot media. The full-iOS root is the sealed System volume on the ANS namespace.
